codeReachabilityReview.nodemailer: Direct runtime dependency used by own-mail and SES transports. own-mail explicitly sets secure:false and ignoreTLS:true; SES defaults to port 587 with requireTLS and only uses implicit TLS when configured on port 465. The DNS SNI advisory GHSA-6vj9-mwq6-2f5v describes a conditional direct-SMTPS/multiple-servername case; reviewed callsites do not establish that condition. Other Nodemailer parser/recipient advisories still require input-flow review; no broad non-exploitability claim.
codeReachabilityReview.betterAuth: Direct runtime auth dependency in public app and admin, with passkey integration in both; update needs a coherent package set and auth regression coverage.
codeReachabilityReview.zod: Direct runtime dependency used across request, configuration, telemetry, payment and admin schemas; compatibility requires broad tests.
